description: The complete editable surface of the Order Samurai harness. A self-harness proposer may ONLY emit diffs against the `values` block of this file. Everything else in the repo is off-limits to automated proposals. Every value here MUST equal the live value of its consumer at the time it was added -- this file is a declaration of what is tunable, never a behavior change.
provenance: M1 of Research/SELF_HARNESS_EVOLUTION_PLAN.md. Each `consumer` below was verified to exist AND to actually read this file on 2026-07-16 -- a declared-but-unwired knob is worse than an absent one, because it reads as governed while nothing enforces it. Planned knobs dropped from v1: `scout_transcript_window_days` (the scout windows by file count, not days -- admitted as `scout_max_files` instead); `judge_max_tokens` at the planned 1024 (live value is 512, so 512 was admitted); `meditation_verification_clause` (no such clause exists in prompts/meditation_cycle.md); `sensei_cycle_timeout_seconds` and `sensei_max_turns` (meditation.env already owns those values and bin/meditation_overnight.sh keeps hand-synced fallback literals -- declaring them here too would create a second source of truth for one number. v2 prerequisite: retire the meditation.env duplicates and make surface.env the single source, which means editing a live unattended runner and is not worth bundling into a behaviour-neutral change). v1 is values-only; there are no instruction surfaces. --- v2 (2026-07-30) admits the first INSTRUCTION knob, `weakness_mechanism_guidance`. The planned meditation.env de-duplication did NOT happen and was dropped rather than deferred: bin/meditation_overnight.sh was halted by owner decision that same day (state/MEDITATION_STOP), so `sensei_cycle_timeout_seconds` and `sensei_max_turns` now have no running consumer, and admitting a knob whose consumer never executes is precisely the declared-but-unwired failure the admission bar exists to prevent. Re-open it only if that runner is ever resumed. The admission bar for text knobs is stricter than for ints and is enforced in three places: bounded `max_chars`, single-line and single-quote-free (so one declaration renders identically for Python and for the TS engine reading surface.env), and -- the bar that makes it a knob rather than a declaration -- an eval task that measurably reddens when the clause is perturbed (evalsuite/tasks/e1_classifies_identical_retry.json, pinned by tests/test_harness_eval_suite.py::test_the_instruction_knob_is_not_a_spectator). Deliberately NOT admitted: the proposer's own prompt. That is L5, and the plan parks it until one full loop iteration has been reviewed.

reflex_cooldown_minutes.note: Per-reflex re-fire cooldown, multiplied by the skill-efficacy multiplier.

loop_breaker_limit.note: Consecutive hard failures before a reflex is parked as stuck.

incomplete_limit.note: Lenient budget for non-finishing runs (quota/turn-cap), weaker evidence than a hard error.

scout_max_files.note: Newest-N transcript files scanned by the nightly quality scouts.

judge_max_tokens.note: Floor is contractual (local_guards): thinking models return empty content below it. min must never drop under 512.

context_cliff_token_threshold.note: Absolute high-context cutoff (window-agnostic) for the Context_Cliff_Events metric.

weakness_mechanism_guidance.value: Which mechanism best describes what the agent did wrong? If none fits, answer "other".
weakness_mechanism_guidance.consumer: Order Samurai/bin/weakness_mining_scout.py _mechanism_guidance() (closing instruction of the mechanism-classifier prompt)
weakness_mechanism_guidance.note: v2's first INSTRUCTION knob. Chosen because its consumer is live on the sensei carrier and its effect is observable in an eval task (e1) rather than only in prose. Bounded at 400 chars and single-line: an unbounded prose knob is an unbounded prompt the harness writes into its own reasoning. It is deliberately NOT the proposer's own prompt -- improving the improver is L5, and the plan parks that until a full loop iteration has been reviewed.

judge_min_n.consumer: agentica_core/aggregate.py _judge_min_n() (min accepted judgments before a transcript-sampled judge metric grades; below it -> SIMULATED)
judge_min_n.note: Min-sample guard for llm-judged, transcript-sampled metrics (tool triad, faithfulness, refusal). Retrieval_Relevance exempt (fixed seed benchmark).
